Cena Privacy Policy and California Notice at Collection

Effective date: [DATE] · Operator: [LEGAL BUSINESS NAME] · Privacy contact: [PRIVACY EMAIL] · [MAILING ADDRESS]

This policy describes the personal information Cena collects through its meal-kit pickup app and restaurant tools, how we use and disclose it, and choices that may be available to you. It covers customers, people who join our waitlist, and restaurant owners and staff. It does not cover a restaurant’s independent handling of information it receives when fulfilling an order; ask the restaurant for its privacy practices.

Notice at Collection

We provide this notice at or before collecting personal information. The table describes our current launch collection. “Not sold/shared” means Cena does not sell the information or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising as those terms are defined by California law. We do not use sensitive personal information to infer characteristics about you.

We do not require optional phone number or equipment preferences to create a customer account. For new orders, customers pay online through Stripe-hosted Checkout. Stripe collects card details directly; Cena receives payment status and reference information but does not receive or store full card numbers. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

Collection points and acknowledgments

We collect account data when you register or edit your profile; order and menu data when you browse or place an order; analytics events only after you opt in; waitlist data when you submit the waitlist form; staff membership data when a restaurant adds or authorizes a staff member; and request data when you use the privacy request form. At these points, the app or form should link to this Notice at Collection and record the applicable notice/version acknowledgment. Current policy version: 2026-11-13. The acknowledgment confirms notice was presented; it is not consent to analytics. Analytics consent must be separate, optional, and revocable in settings.

How we use information

We use personal information to provide and maintain Cena; create accounts; display restaurant meal kits; route orders and pickup instructions; communicate about orders or support; manage restaurant access; secure, troubleshoot, and prevent misuse of the Service; honor privacy choices; and comply with law. We use consented first-party analytics to understand how the app is used and improve it. We do not use analytics information for targeted advertising.

Information comes directly from you (account, profile, waitlist, and privacy request fields); from your use of Cena (menu interactions, orders, pickup status, and consented app analytics); from Stripe (payment statuses and payment references); and from a restaurant administrator who invites or manages a staff member. Stripe collects card details through its hosted Checkout and sends Cena only the payment information needed to update orders and support transactions. We do not buy personal information or obtain it from data brokers for this Service.

If you ask for recipe or preparation help, the app may send recipe data to OpenAI for that feature. In the launch design this feature receives recipe data only, not your account email, display name, phone number, order history, or restaurant staff membership data. Do not include personal information in free text submitted to the feature. OpenAI processes data under its applicable terms and privacy practices; [confirm the specific service, configuration, retention, and contractual terms before launch].

When we disclose information

We disclose information as follows:

  • Participating restaurant: We share the customer information needed to accept and fulfill an order, such as the order details and any contact or pickup information shown for that order. The restaurant uses that information to fulfill and support the order and is responsible for its own handling.
  • Service providers: We use providers for hosting, database, authentication, communications, security, first-party analytics, and payment processing. Stripe processes card data through hosted Checkout and handles payments for restaurants; it may process information under its own terms and applicable agreements.
  • OpenAI: Recipe data only, when you invoke the recipe/preparation feature described above.
  • Legal and safety: We may disclose information where reasonably necessary to comply with law, respond to valid legal process, protect rights or safety, investigate fraud or security incidents, or establish or defend legal claims.
  • Business transfer: Information may transfer as part of a merger, financing, reorganization, or sale, subject to applicable law and appropriate protections.

We do not sell personal information or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. We do not disclose personal information to third parties for their own direct marketing. If these practices change, we will update this policy and provide any choices and notices required by law before the change takes effect.

Your privacy choices and rights

You may opt out of consented analytics at any time in [APP SETTINGS LOCATION]. Turning analytics off does not affect core ordering. You may update profile details in the app. You may unsubscribe from waitlist emails using the link in the message or contact us.

Depending on your location and whether applicable privacy law covers Cena, you may have rights to know/access, delete, correct, or obtain a portable copy of certain personal information; opt out of sale or sharing; limit certain uses or disclosures of sensitive personal information; and not face discrimination for exercising a privacy right. We do not currently sell or share personal information as defined by California law, and do not use sensitive personal information for purposes that would trigger a right to limit. Rights may be subject to exceptions and verification requirements.

We do not currently sell or share personal information, so there is no sale/sharing opt-out to process at this time. We do not use sensitive personal information for purposes that trigger the right to limit. We do not currently act on browser-based Global Privacy Control or other opt-out preference signals because we do not engage in those activities; if our practices change, we will update this policy and honor signals as required by law. You can still turn off optional analytics consent in app settings.

Submit a privacy request

Use this form to request access, a copy, correction, or deletion of information associated with your account. Do not include passwords, payment data, or sensitive personal details. We’ll use the contact information only to process your request under our Privacy Policy.

We may contact you to verify the request. Do not include your password.

How to submit a privacy request

Use our #privacy-request-form or email [PRIVACY EMAIL] with the subject “Privacy Request.” You may ask us to access, correct, delete, or receive a copy of information associated with your account, or opt out of analytics consent. Tell us your request type and the email associated with your account. We will verify requests by matching the request to the account email and, when reasonably necessary, asking for limited additional account information; we will not ask for your password. An authorized agent may submit a request where applicable law permits, and we may require evidence of authority or direct verification from you.

We will respond within the period required by applicable law. If we cannot fulfill a request, we will explain why and provide any review or appeal process that applies. A request concerning information held by a restaurant should be sent to that restaurant as well. If you contact us to delete an account, we may retain information needed to complete outstanding orders, address safety or security matters, comply with law, or establish, exercise, or defend legal claims, and will delete or de-identify it when that need ends.

Security and retention

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure. Retention periods in the Notice at Collection are current planning periods, not guarantees; we retain information only as long as reasonably needed for the stated purposes, unless law permits or requires longer retention. We then delete, aggregate, or de-identify it.

Children

Cena is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information. If you believe a child has provided information, contact [PRIVACY EMAIL] so we can review and delete it as appropriate.

Changes and contact

We may revise this policy as the Service or law changes. We will post the updated version and date, and provide additional notice or obtain consent where required. Contact [LEGAL BUSINESS NAME], [MAILING ADDRESS], [PRIVACY EMAIL], or use the #privacy-request-form for privacy questions or requests.
